newsitem.title: USA: Above normal temps expected in US South in Feb - NWS.
newsitem.headline: Above normal temps expected in US South in Feb - NWS.

text.p: The National Weather Service on Thursday said it expects above normal temperatures in February in a large portion of the southern tier of the United States.

The above normal temperatures are expected in southern parts of California, Nevada and New Mexico, throughout the South Atlantic Seaboard and extending as far north as southern Pennsylvania and Delaware, the NWS said in its monthly report.
The NWS also said it forecasts below median precipitation in most of Florida.
There were no indications of abnormal temperatures and precipitation for the rest of the country.
The next 30-day outlook will be issued Thursday, February 13.
